title: Customer Service
subtitle: Customer-service agents for strangers — they answer only from knowledge bases and service notes; dangerous capabilities are never registered.

trust.readonly: Only three read-only tools: knowledge search / knowledge read / service notes
trust.locked: Terminal / files / computer / browser capabilities are never registered

empty.title: No customer-service agents yet
empty.desc: Create an agent, bind knowledge bases and a service policy, then bind channel bots so it can safely serve visitors.

fields.name: Name
fields.greetingPlaceholder: Opening line when a visitor says hello
fields.personaPlaceholder: Tone and persona, e.g. patient, concise, factual
fields.servicePolicyPlaceholder: Business scope / off-limits topics / compliance phrasing

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? Its bindings, dialogues and private notes will be removed.

bindings.domainHint: Customer service uses its own channel bots, fully independent from desktop companions' channels.
bindings.noBots: No customer-service channel bots yet — create one here; it will be bound to this agent automatically.
bindings.autoBound: Created and bound to this agent automatically
bindings.hint: Once bound, every inbound message on that bot is served by this agent (strangers need no pairing code).

notes.empty: No notes yet — put FAQs / scripts / business facts here; agents reference them read-only.
notes.contentPlaceholder: Write an FAQ / script / business fact…
notes.aliasesPlaceholder:
Alternate phrasings, one per line, e.g. this app
how much
notes.aliasesHint: One phrasing a visitor might use per line. These are what make a note findable when the visitor words the question differently from the note body.
notes.sharedHint: Share with every agent (unchecked = this agent only)
notes.scopeLocked: The note scope cannot be changed after creation
